extracted.intended_audience: investigators preparing/submitting an NIH R01 (PA-13-302) application (NIAID sample)
extracted.subtask_description: Sample NIAID R01 application and its attachments illustrating the required forms, narrative sections (Project Summary/Abstract, Project Narrative), facilities/resources/equipment descriptions, biosketches, and budget information for an R01 submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow funding opportunity instructions for application format
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although this application demonstrates good grantsmanship, time has passed since the grantee applied. The samples may not reflect the latest format or rules. NIAID posts new samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract (required content)
rubrics_metrics.description: PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT — state the problem, critical gaps, long-term goals, central hypothesis, specific aims, strong preliminary data, and potential impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample abstract summarizes significance ('Polyomaviruses cause...'), long-term goals (identify how viruses subvert host processes), central hypothesis (activated DDR facilitates viral replication), three Specific Aims, and potential broad impacts/extrapolation to other DNA viruses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative (public health relevance)
rubrics_metrics.description: PROJECT NARRATIVE — provide a concise statement of the public health relevance of the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample narrative emphasizes relevance (polyomaviruses associated with severe diseases and cancers) and describes how the research may reveal novel therapeutic host targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declare Human Subjects involvement and related compliance information
rubrics_metrics.description: Are Human Subjects Involved? If YES: indicate whether project is Exempt; if not, state whether IRB review is pending and provide IRB Approval Date and Human Subject Assurance Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form R&R asks explicit checkboxes and follow-up fields (1.a). Even when 'No' is selected, the question must be answered on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declare Vertebrate Animals involvement and related compliance information
rubrics_metrics.description: Are Vertebrate Animals Used? If YES: indicate whether IACUC review is pending and provide IACUC Approval Date and Animal Welfare Assurance Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form R&R asks explicit checkboxes and follow-up fields (2.a). Provide approvals/assurance numbers if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proprietary/privileged information disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether proprietary/privileged information is included in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form includes a checkbox for proprietary/privileged information; disclose to allow appropriate handling/redactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental impact disclosure and NEPA compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project has an actual or potential impact on the environment and, if yes, whether an exemption has been authorized or an environmental assessment (EA) or environmental impact statement (EIS) performed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', provide explanation and note whether EA/EIS has been done (questions 4.a–4.c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Historic place designation of performance site
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the research performance site is designated, or eligible to be designated, as a historic place and provide explanation if yes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form asks this as a compliance/administrative item (question 5).

rubrics_metrics.name: International activities disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project involves activities outside the United States or partnerships with international collaborators; if yes, identify countries and provide optional explanation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form R&R includes fields (6 and 6.a/6.b) to list countries and provide explanation for international work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide required file attachments with correct content and MIME types
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Project Summary/Abstract, Project Narrative, Bibliography & References Cited, Facilities & Other Resources, Equipment, etc., with proper filenames and MIME types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample lists file attachments and mime types (e.g., Project_Abstract_Final.pdf application/pdf). Ensure each required attachment is included and properly labeled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — laboratory description
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe laboratory space (approximate square footage), biosafety level (e.g., BSL-2), equipment present (biosafety cabinets, CO2 incubators), and location relative to PI offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample specifies ~1000 sq ft BSL-2 lab, two 4-ft biosafety cabinets, two CO2 incubators, and office adjacent to lab for communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — biohazards, approvals and training
rubrics_metrics.description: Document designated approved areas for handling infectious agents, plan to obtain Occupational Health and Safety approvals, schedule for annual laboratory audits, and training requirements for lab personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample notes designated/approved areas for BK polyomavirus and lentivirus, requirement to obtain UAB Occupational Health and Safety Office approval, annual audits, and yearly retraining.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — institutional/shared core facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: List major university core facilities and shared resources available to support the project (imaging, EM, flow cytometry, mass spectrometry, NGS, animal facilities, biostatistics/bioinformatics, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample provides an extensive list of UAB cores (high resolution imaging, EM, flow cytometry, mass spec, Heflin Center for Genomic Sciences, animal facilities, biostatistics, X-ray crystallography, NMR, tissue procurement, hybridoma, biofermentation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — administrative and departmental support
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe departmental support including protected research effort percentage, mentoring committee, administrative personnel support, retreats, and collaborative environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample states at least 80% protected research effort, mentoring committee formed by department chair, annual faculty and department retreats, and regular seminar/meeting structures to facilitate collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computing and telecommunications resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Document availability of computers, software suites, network access, printers/scanners, and telecommunication to support data analysis and collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample lists PCs and laptops, Microsoft Office, Adobe, DNA/proteomics analysis software, statistics and graphic software, linked to department network and storage server for backup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment — major and shared instrumentation
rubrics_metrics.description: List major equipment available in the PI's lab and in collaborating labs, plus department-shared equipment with specifics (e.g., sequencers, plate readers, incubators, freezers, centrifuges).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample enumerates incubators, freezers (-80°C, -20°C), microscopes, centrifuges, thermocycler, plate reader (CLARIOstar), ABI QuantStudio 7 Flex, imaging systems, RT-PCR machines, etc., and concludes that necessary equipment is in place to carry out proposed studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch (Biosketch) format and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a biographical sketch for senior/key personnel following specified format and DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES. Include education/training, personal statement, positions and honors, contributions to science, and complete bibliography link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample includes BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH instructions (OMB No. etc.), a Personal Statement explaining qualifications, lists of Publications and Contributions to Science, and explicit 'DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan sections and Table of Contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Research Plan components (Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Bibliography & References Cited, Letters of Support) and list their page numbers in the Table of Contents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample Table of Contents enumerates forms and Research Plan sections with page numbers (e.g., Specific Aims page 32, Research Strategy page 33, Bibliography page 45, Letters of Support page 50).

rubrics_metrics.name: SF424 required organizational and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide organizational identifiers and contact info including Organizational DUNS, Legal Name, Department, Street Address, City/State/ZIP, Person to be contacted (name, phone, email), and EIN/TIN.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample SF424 R&R fields show required institutional identifiers and the point-of-contact details for matters involving the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of application and related checkboxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate type of submission (e.g., New, Resubmission, Renewal, Continuation, Revision) and whether the application is being submitted to other agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample marks 'New' and includes checkboxes for other submission types and asks 'Is this application being submitted to other agencies?' with follow-up fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certifications and assurances and authorized representative signature
rubrics_metrics.description: By signing the application, the authorized representative certifies to the statements in the list of certifications and assurances, attests to truth/completeness, agrees to comply with resulting terms, and acknowledges penalties for false statements; include authorized representative name, title, signature and date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample includes explicit certification text and fields for the Authorized Representative (name, title, organization, signature, date).

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — human subjects / clinical trial flags & permission statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer whether the proposed project involves a clinical trial (human subjects), whether it is an agency-defined Phase III clinical trial, and a permission statement about government disclosure of project title/contact info if application does not result in award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement includes checkboxes for clinical trial status, phase III designation, and the Permission Statement checkbox.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — program income reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether program income is anticipated during the budget periods; if yes, provide anticipated amounts and sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form asks 'Is program income anticipated?' and if yes requires amounts and sources per budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — human embryonic stem cell disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells (HESC); if yes, list registration number(s) from NIH registry or check that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample includes the HESC checkbox and instructions to list registry numbers or indicate a registry line will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents reporting for renewals
rubrics_metrics.description: For renewal applications, indicate whether inventions and patents exist and whether they were previously reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PHS 398 includes 'Inventions and Patents (For renewal applications only)' with follow-up fields if 'Yes.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: If there is a change of principal investigator/program director or change of grantee institution, provide the name of the former PI or former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement contains checkboxes and fields to report changes in PI or institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Budget and budget details
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide modular budget period dates, Direct Costs requested (less consortium F&A), Consortium F&A, Total Direct Costs, Indirect Cost type and rate, and Personnel Justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample PHS 398 Modular Budget shows fields for funds requested, indirect cost rates and types, and indicates where personnel justification and modular budget items must be specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person Profile attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide expanded profiles for Senior/Key persons with fields for name, position title, organization, degree, degree year, project role, and attach Biographical Sketch and Current & Pending Support documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample 'PROFILE - Project Director/Principal Investigator' includes fields and file attachment slots (Attach Biographical Sketch*, Attach Current & Pending Support).

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limits and format constraints for forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhere to explicit page limits and format constraints stated for specific forms (e.g., Biosketch: DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES) and the general instruction to follow FOA/application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample contains explicit page-limit instruction for biosketch and the earlier admonition to follow current FOA instructions because sample may be out-of-date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigator status declarations (New Investigator / Early Stage Investigator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate New Investigator and Early Stage Investigator status on the application as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample application includes fields 'New Investigator: Y' and 'Early Stage Investigator: Y' to declare investigator status.
